critic_flags.reason: Internal control under Annex VI for an Annex III point 4 system is what Art 43(2) states; the flag rests only on the 'before placing on the market' timing, which is substantively correct (project decision, Phase 7.5).

Art 5(1)(c) prohibits 'the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use'; it does not prohibit development. The obligation adds 'develop'. The wording comes from our prohibited-tier obligation rule ('must not be developed, placed on the market, put into service or used').
Same as PG1: Art 43(2) covers Annex III points 2 to 8 with internal control; the flag is the over-literal timing point.

Art 5(1)(h) prohibits only 'the use of' real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement, and only 'unless and in so far as' one of objectives (i) to (iii) applies. The obligation adds develop, placing on the market and putting into service, and states the ban as absolute. Same origin as PG3: our prohibited-tier obligation rule.
